method.bootstrap: paired article-level nonparametric percentile bootstrap; 95% pointwise CIs
method.changed_subset: Post-selection descriptive view only; no inferential CI.
method.references: GPT and Gemini separate; per-article equal-weight mean is secondary; no best-reference selection.
method.inference_scope: Empirical article variation only; not model training, references, topics, or run randomness.
method.multiplicity: CIs are pointwise, without multiplicity correction; no p-values or overall quality claim.
